name: remvu
description: Save project context and resume in another coding agent. No Python required for the Markdown workflow.

interface.longDescription: Use save and resume to carry project goals, constraints, rejected approaches and unfinished work between Claude Code and Codex. The default Markdown skill needs no Python, hooks or Remvu account. Optional Python tools provide strict validation and observable event recording. Hidden reasoning is excluded; see the compatibility report for verified clients.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Remvu save to prepare a local handoff, or resume to continue from one.
